name: AISDR
summary: Deploy an autonomous AI Sales Development Rep. It qualifies leads, books meetings, and handles initial outreach conversations 24/7.
best_for: sales teams with a clear ICP and offer that want autonomous AI to qualify leads, personalize outreach and book meetings around the clock
skip_if: you haven't nailed your targeting and messaging yet (automation will scale the wrong thing, and you pay $1.50 for every person it reaches), or you need a published team-plan price before talking to sales
honest_knock: Judge it on cost per meeting, not the sticker. Pay as you go at $1.50 per person contacted removes the old entry barrier, but the bill grows with every person you contact, so a weak list costs you money as well as sender reputation. Autonomous AI outreach is only as good as your targeting, list quality and messaging guardrails; point it at a bad list and you'll automate bad outreach. For teams with a solid ICP and offer it can book meetings at a real cost per meeting; for those still figuring out messaging, it's premature. Ami, the GTM agent AiSDR shipped in September 2026, is now the front door on every route: you hand it your website, it comes back with a target list and a campaign, and it keeps adjusting the ones that stall, with your ICP, exclusions and past lessons carried over between campaigns. The scale numbers on the launch page (17,150 campaigns learned from, 19,501 meetings behind them, a rolling 30-day pipeline counter) are AiSDR's own and unaudited, so read them as marketing rather than evidence. And Ami changes none of the deliverability arithmetic: a first campaign in minutes is the launch, not the result.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per person contacted (charged daily, no subscription)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on aisdr.com/pricing and AiSDR's plain-text pricing reference for AI assistants, aisdr.com/pricing-for-llms, marked 'Last updated: 2026-10-15') AiSDR has replaced its published plan ladder with two routes. Pay as you go: $1.50 per person contacted, charged daily for the people contacted that day, with no subscription, no monthly fee, no contract and no sales call. You pick a pace of 5, 10 or 20 people a day, which the page itself works out as $7.50, $15 or $30 a day, and research, lists and writing are included in the $1.50. The reference says campaigns start from as little as $3; another FAQ on the main pricing page says from $7.50. Team plans are for teams contacting 1,000+ people a month: priced on volume with 'up to 40% lower price per contact', no amount published, billed monthly from the day you sign up on a quarterly or annual contract, with annual 20% cheaper than quarterly. Each team plan includes a monthly contact limit; extra contacts are bought in the app at a price the page does not publish. Add-ons: warmed-up mailbox $33 per mailbox setup, per-campaign managed service $149 per campaign, fully managed service $2,500 per month. Historical: until at least 11 October 2026 AiSDR published Solo at $250/mo, Explore at $900/mo and Scale at $2,500/mo; none of those plans appears on either page on 15 October 2026.
